name: B10-0148/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize MON 89034 × 1507 × NK603 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the authorisation of a genetically modified maize (MON 89034 × 1507 × NK603) for use in food and feed. The maize is engineered to tolerate the herbicide glyphosate and to produce insect-killing toxins. Parliament says the weedkiller risks were not properly assessed, that the maize may harm non-target species, and that Member States never backed the plan. The resolution is an objection, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only objects and asks the Commission to withdraw its draft decision.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed importers, and consumers across the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw the plan or go ahead with the authorisation.
